description: The CLI versions each mailbox hook adapter is proven against (docs/platform/agent-mailbox/spec.md §4.1, spelled testedAgainst here), and the measured hook facts of each drained CLI (hookFacts). A version is listed only when its Stop and PostToolUse payloads and the output shapes the CLI injected were recorded on it; the fixtures live under fixtures/hooks/<cli>/. hookFacts are per CLI, not per version: hookTopology (direct: the CLI starts the hook itself; one-shell-hop: through one shell that does not exec it), hookShell (the path the CLI invokes for the hook command, checked against the hop parent's executable and argv[0]; null for direct), headExecutables (exe basenames accepted at the direct head position) and postToolUseContextMaxBytes (the bound of a PostToolUse drain's output; null means no PostToolUse drain). measuredOn names the versions the facts were measured on; re-recording a new version re-measures them. A CLI of the first slice that could not be proven is listed under deferred with its reason, never left out silently.
source: hookFacts: plans/reports/research-261023-0148-mailbox-v5-measurements.md tables (b), (c), (d), (e), (f) and (g); the bound applies plan decision 6's margin rule for a threshold shown to apply per hook (the largest inline ladder step, 9,216 bytes, less one ladder step of 1,024 bytes), in both CLIs

deferred.reason: not drained: an agy subagent runs as its own conversation whose events carry no marker and which fires its own Stop, so no agy event can be told to be the head's; and agy 1.4.4 refused both PostToolUse context shapes (protojson: unknown field additionalContext, unknown field hookSpecificOutput; its post-tool hook result has only overwriteResult, rejected as a channel). The Stop block and the payloads are recorded under fixtures/hooks/agy/. Unblocked by a payload field naming the parent conversation or a hook scope for the head conversation only
